headline: Approved previous meeting minutes; discussed traffic box designs, the Poly-Resin Heart Sculpture, Mum Festival booth, and upcoming events.
summary: Members approved the minutes of the previous meeting. Discussion covered traffic box designs, the Poly-Resin Heart Sculpture, the Mum Festival booth, and upcoming arts events.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the August 5, 2026 regular meeting, all in favor.

plain_text:
City of Bristol 
Arts & Culture Commission 
 
INFORMATION TO ACCESS MEETING 
https://bristolct-gov.zoom.us/j/83837598503?pwd=7mmPQw4bSobMWVv0x40Niq9zNhCcqm.1 
 
of the Arts & Culture Commission 
September 2, 2026 - 6:00 PM 
 
Ladies and Gentlemen: 
 
The regular meeting was held on Wednesday, September 2, 2026, at 6:00 PM in Meeting Room 1-3 in 
City Hall, 111 North Main Street, Bristol, CT 06010. 
 
1. Call to Order 
Chair Lewandoski called the meeting to order at 6:00 p.m. 
 a. Pledge of Allegiance 
 
 
 
 b. Attendance 
 Members Present: Chair Walter Lewandowski 
Vice Chair Andrea Adams 
Commissioner Julie Crist  
Commissioner Juliet Norton 
Commissioner Maria Salice 
Commissioner Nigel Wynter 
Commissioner E. Brad Yancy 
City Council Liaison Greg Hahn 
Arts and Culture Supervisor Arianna Theriault 
  
Absent: None 
  
 
2. Approval of Minutes 
 
 a. Approval of Minutes: August 5, 2026, City Arts and Culture Regular Meeting 
Minutes
MOTION: Made by Vice Chair Adams to approve the August 5, 2026, City Arts and 
Culture Commission Regular Meeting. 
Seconded by Commissioner Crist; all in favor; motion carried. 
 
3. Public Participation 
Victoria Biondi, Treasurer of the New England Carousel Museum's Museum Board, presented 
upcoming events at the museum, such as Glow Sessions, a collaboration with Creative Art 
Jam. Discussion followed.  
 
MOTION: Made by Vice Chair Adams to move the Chairman's Report up on the agenda. 
Commissioner Wynter; all in favor; motion carried.  
5. Chairman's Report 
Chair Lewandoski presented an update on the Poly-Resin Heart Sculpture. Chair Lewandoski 
planned to attend the Veterans Council Meeting to present the Military-themed mural to be 
created on the concrete wall of the Urban Garden on Veterans Memorial Boulevard; discussion 
followed.  
4. Arts and Culture Supervisor's Report 
 
 a. Supervisor's Report 
 Arts and Culture Supervisor Arianna Therriault presented the Supervisor's Report. 
Supervisor Therriault updated the commission on current ticket sales, upcoming 
Downtown Live shows at the Rockwell Theater, the newest sponsorship with Lake 
Compounce, and the Part-Time Arts and Culture position. Discussion followed. 
 
 b. Project Spreadsheet 
 Nothing to Report 
 
 c. Year-to-Date Financials 
 Nothing to report.  
 
6. Old Business 
 
 a. Traffic Box Updates: Cassandra Sims at Stafford Ave and Washington Street, 
and Joe Johnson and Chair Lewandoski at Green Hills and Pine Street. 
 Commissioner Crist presented an update on the partnership with Home Depot and will 
meet with them on September 7, 2026. Cassandra Sims accepted the project but is 
waiting to hear the results of the Home Depot meeting. Chair Lewandoski and Joe 
Johnson are still working on their design for the Pine Street location; Discussion followed.
b. Poly Resin Heart Update 
 Arts and Culture Supervisor Therriault presented the update on the Poly-Resin Heart 
Sculpture. Amanda Mendoza completed the painting, and Supervisor Therriault scheduled 
pickup for next week. Discussion followed.  
 
 c. Mum Festival: Confirm Time Slots from Commission Members & Home Depot 
Involvement 
 Vice Chair Andrea Adams presented information about the Arts and Culture Commission's 
booth at the Mum Festival. Discussion followed.  
 
 d. Confirm Plaque Verbiage for Heart Sculptures 
 Arts and Culture Supervisor Theriault presented the plaque verbiage for the Heart 
Sculptures. Discussion followed.  
 
 e. By Commissioners  
 Nothing to report. 
 
7. New Business 
 
 a. By Commissioners 
 Commissioner Salice informed the commission that the Louise Lauretano DeMars Love of 
Art Fund for performing artists will be released soon. Commissioner Salice will send out 
the information to the commission once it is available. Discussion followed.  
 
Commissioner Crist informed the commission that Gloria Dei Lutheran Church will host a 
Multi-Cultural Day on September 19, 2026. Discussion followed.  
 
Commissioner Norton informed the commission of an event at the New England Carousel 
Museum with Megan Minor of Lake Compounce, and asked about hosting a movie night 
to coincide with the Bristol Historical Society's Annual West Cemetery Lantern Tours. 
Discussion followed.  
 
8. Reports and Committee Reports 
 
 a. City Council Liaison Report 
 City Council Liaison Hahn updated the commission about the city's consideration of 
purchasing Chippanee Golf Course. An informational meeting is tomorrow for the 
community to share their thoughts on the proposed purchase. Discussion followed.
9. Adjournment 
MOTION: Made by Commissioner Crist to adjourn at 7:05 p.m. 
Seconded by Commissioner Salice; all in favor; motion carried.  
  
Respectfully Submitted,  
Amaris Estrada 
Recording Secretary 
City Arts and Culture Commission
